decision_strength: per arm: 2.5 / 2.5 / 0.0; collection enabled in all arms

declaration.candidate_law: Before singleton return and learned scoring, retain original top24 candidates and optionally append up to24 actually experienced alternative tokens from the nearest available strictly shorter suffix at depth>=3. Support membership requires ordinary-credit trials>0, independently of reward values. Respect corridor veto. Added counts total original retained counts*.10/.90, proportional to that shorter suffix counts. Existing logits/heads/outcome acquisition unchanged. Zero mass preserves old sampling and RNG law.
declaration.same_inputs: All arms start from the published 800-game 2048 state; same corpus, source/behavior replay judge, generation/environment seeds, original attempt budgets. All collect and update decision credit; zero readout disables only its logit contribution. Resulting histories may diverge.
declaration.primary: Completed episode score per original generation attempt; incomplete episodes and every syntax/runtime/replay/truncation/encoding failure receive zero in original slot.
declaration.gate: support minus baseline completed score/raw must be positive in BOTH development replicas, pooled >=25 points/raw, and pooled completed count >=baseline. support_zero_readout is explanatory, not an automatic promotion criterion. One fixed candidate and mass, no hyperparameter sweep.
declaration.controls: Uniform random legal and fixed greedy merge/empty/LDRU, every evaluation environment seed,128 moves; no generated-policy replacement.
declaration.targets: Unchanged H8 discounted actual observed gains,gamma.9,available-window normalization,episode-centered bounded targets preserving mean reward. No oracle action or RNG substitution.
declaration.mechanism: After final training, replay the same64 eval generation seeds per replica on frozen support final snapshots: genuine; support mass0; decision strength0; ordinary-credit value pairs permuted over sorted keys; decision-credit value pairs permuted over sorted keys. Deterministic shuffle seeds83001+replica and83002+replica. Preserve all other memory and RNG fields. No new game rollouts. Record sources, choices, matched-history candidate counts/logits/probabilities, first differing token and support-admission witnesses. Source/probability differences are mechanism diagnostics, separate from game quality. Genuine final sources must equal closed eval journals; every variant snapshot unchanged by seeded generation.
declaration.gallery_selection: Replica0 first eval seed where support completes and baseline fails (replay/error/incomplete); if none, first completed support episode. Within selected policy first generation choice admitting an experienced shorter-context alternative. No score selection. Show exact generated source and actual trajectory.
declaration.evidence: Frozen source,bridge,input,declaration and runner SHA256 before attempts; immutable per-index JSON receipts; atomic complete JSONL with shard hash manifests/readback. Every attempt and training update accounted, final checkpoints only. Released state never changed by runner.
